:

 Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant; learned Aga for the State and perused the records.
2.

The present application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail
apprehending arrest in in Case Crime No.0119 of 2020, under Sections 147, 452, 323, 504, 506,
376/511 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Police Station - Aaspur Devsara, District - Pratapgarh.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the co-accused, namely, Krishna Murti Pandey Lodh has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 28.05.2025 passed in CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C. No. 597 of 2025.
Therefore, applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
4. Learned AGA opposes the bail application.
5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 28.05.2025, ground of parity, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
The present application for anticipatory bail is accordingly allowed.
(d) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
